fields.label: Patrols stop at
fields.note: Scheduled patrols spawn only while the living AI enemies, the queued ones and the new squad total at most this (the game's 100). The patrol caps count only under it. Today the game crashes past about 400 living enemies (the AI's navmesh query batch) and past about 545 (the entity table), until HellForge's engine fixes for them are in your version. Applies at once. In co-op the host's game spawns and despawns, so only the host's values count.

fields.label: Roaming spawns stop at
fields.note: The shared spawners' waves, travellers and stragglers spawn only while fewer enemies than this are alive, not counting those of breaches, drops and fabricators (the game's 70). Applies at once. In co-op the host's game spawns and despawns, so only the host's values count.

fields.label: Other spawns stop at
fields.note: No spawn but a patrol's while this many AI enemies are alive (the game's 448): bug holes, fabricators, drops, breaches and outposts stop there. Today the game crashes past about 400 living enemies (the AI's navmesh query batch) and past about 545 (the entity table), until HellForge's engine fixes for them are in your version. Applies at once. In co-op the host's game spawns and despawns, so only the host's values count.

fields.label: Despawn enemies
fields.note: Yes (the game's): once enough enemies are alive the game despawns about one a second, far ones first, so new patrols only replace them. No: no living enemy is despawned, so the count keeps rising. Today the game crashes past about 400 living enemies (the AI's navmesh query batch) and past about 545 (the entity table), until HellForge's engine fixes for them are in your version. Applies at once. In co-op the host's game spawns and despawns, so only the host's values count.

fields.label: Despawning starts at
fields.note: The despawning starts once this many enemies are alive (the game's 100), taking those past the despawn distance; from ten more it takes any enemy. Applies at once. In co-op the host's game spawns and despawns, so only the host's values count.

fields.label: Despawn distance
fields.note: Enemies this far from the players may be despawned first (the game's 150 m). Applies at once. In co-op the host's game spawns and despawns, so only the host's values count.

fields.label: Patrols stop at

fields.label: Roaming spawns stop at
